title: Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Banaza, a merchant summoned to another world as a hero candidate, is judged weak and dumped in a monster forest, where his powers suddenly explode. Taking the name Flio, he marries the demon wolf Rys and tries to live quietly, but keeps getting pulled into other people's troubles. His growing circle of humans and demons slowly works toward ending a 500-year war.
life_message: It holds up a peaceful home life and friendship across enemy lines over glory in battle.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Flio shrugs off the kingdom's insult of exiling him and seeks no revenge.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Flio wants to be left alone in the forest, away from kingdom and Dark Army.

Civic vs kin.evidence: His wife and adopted family come before any nation.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Rys's tribe values submission to the strong, but Flio treats all as equals.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Tribal customs and magic sit alongside practical problem-solving.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Comfort and quality of life, a 'chill' life, are the stated goal.

folkways.japan: The 'slow life' isekai ideal, escape from a demanding workplace-like kingdom and a domestic wife figure reflect Japanese web-novel genre norms.

winners_losers: Flio, his family and peace-seekers on both sides win; war-hungry nobles and the summoning kingdom lose. Sympathy goes to coexistence and home life.
